_key.description: Coding variant key, phenotype ontology term and source file accession, joined by underscores.

esm_1v_score.description: Combined ESM-1v score for the substitution: the mean of the five model scores. Where a protein longer than 1022 amino acids was split into overlapping segments, the two segment means are blended across the overlap with a cosine sigmoid. More negative scores indicate greater predicted deleteriousness. Only substitutions scoring below log(0.5) are loaded.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the IGVF file this measurement was read from.

esm1v_t33_650M_UR90S_1.description: Masked-marginals score for the substitution from the esm1v_t33_650M_UR90S_1 model, one of the five ESM-1v models. Where the position falls in an overlap between two segments of a long protein, this is the score from the earlier segment.

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for the sample the assay was run in, taken from the file's fileset metadata. Null when the fileset lists no sample.

biological_context.description: Plain-language summary of the sample the assay was run in, taken from the file's fileset metadata. Null when the fileset carries no summary.
